job.job_description:
We are looking for a Senior GenAI Platform Engineer with 6-9 years of experience in managing LLM-based systems, GenAI infrastructure, and cloud-native AI platforms. The role involves designing scalable GenAI architectures, optimizing performance, and leading deployment pipelines for LLM solutions.

Responsibilities
Design and manage scalable infrastructure for LLM-based systems.
Lead prompt tuning, model fine-tuning, and versioning strategies.
Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines for GenAI deployments.
Ensure scalability, performance, and governance of AI workloads.
Collaborate with teams for deployment and optimization of AI solutions.

Mandatory Skills:

Python
SQL
AWS/Azure/GCP
LLMs
MLOps
Docker
Kubernetes
CI/CD
Terraform

Good to Have:

Hugging Face
PyTorch
MLflow
Spark
Hadoop
Model Explainability
NoSQL
